analysis.limits: Public source only; lexical inventory, not sound slicing, ranges or reachability proof.

verification.scope: Reviewer-transcribed pivot selection on finite development checks only
limits: Finite checks are not full-domain proof, whole-plan correctness or quantum execution.
Excluded states and a declared fallback are not verified repairs.
Ambiguous, withdrawn or unsupported claims are not automatic successes.
